device.description: 12-bit voltage-output DAC with 8-bit parallel microcontroller interface and power down
device.note: slas174b.pdf (SLAS174B) p.1-2 pinout and terminal functions, p.5 recommended operating conditions, p.6 timing, p.11 general function (power-on reset all zero) and parallel interface, p.12 pin/bit tables, data format, address bits and control register

registers.name: IN
registers.note: DAC MSW (4-bit) and LSW (8-bit) holding latches; power-on reset clears them (all bits zero)

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: 12-bit DAC latch, loaded from the holding latches while LDAC is low or RLDAC = 1

commands.name: LSW (RLDAC transparent)
commands.note: write into the DAC LSW holding latch (A1 A0 = 00): D7-D0 -> DAC bits 7-0; with RLDAC = 1 the DAC latch is transparent, so the output follows

commands.name: LSW
commands.note: write into the DAC LSW holding latch (A1 A0 = 00): D7-D0 -> DAC bits 7-0

commands.name: MSW (RLDAC transparent)
commands.note: write into the DAC MSW holding latch (A1 A0 = 01): D3-D0 -> DAC bits 11-8, D7-D4 don't care; with RLDAC = 1 the DAC latch is transparent

commands.name: MSW
commands.note: write into the DAC MSW holding latch (A1 A0 = 01): D3-D0 -> DAC bits 11-8, D7-D4 don't care

commands.name: Control
commands.note: control register (A1 A0 = 11); writing RLDAC = 1 makes the DAC latch transparent (trigger: update)

protocol.note: data and address latched on the rising edge of WE while CS is low; address A1 A0 selects LSW / MSW holding latch or control register

ldac.note: LDAC low: DAC latch transparent (asynchronous, may be held low)

pages: p.1-2 pinout and terminal functions, p.5 recommended operating conditions, p.6 timing, p.11 general function (power-on reset all zero) and parallel interface, p.12 pin/bit tables, data format, address bits and control register
notModeled: analog: voltage output (x2 buffer), reference input REF
SPD pin and CTRL.SPD bit (settling speed, analog only; stored only)
PWD pin (power down, active low) and CTRL.PWD bit: analog power-down only, stored only (the interface keeps working in the model)
RLDAC = 1 transparent latch: modeled as an update on each holding-latch write while RLDAC = 1 and on writing RLDAC = 1
power-on reset threshold (POR 0.55-2 V) and timing checks (setup/hold) are not modeled
p.7 Figures 2/3 label the MSW cycle A = 0 and LSW A = 1, contradicting the p.12 address table and the p.15 example code (MSW at 1, LSW at 0); the table is followed
variants: TLV5633 is the same interface with an internal programmable reference (REF1:0 control bits)
